Package com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.com

Communication related automation scripting object model for the system description.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    IAbstractSignalInstance
    The system signals and system signal groups to be data-mapped are represented by a signal instance (IAbstractSignalInstance).
    IClientServerDataMapping
    IClientServerDataMapping represents the mapping of IOperationCommunicationElements to an ISignalInstance for the call and an ISignalInstance for the return value.
    ICommunicationElement
    A data element, an operation or a trigger to be data-mapped is represented by an ICommunicationElement.
    IDataCommunicationElement
    IDataCommunicationElement represents a data element.
    IDataMapping
    IDataMapping represents the mapping of an IDataCommunicationElement (ISenderReceiverDataMapping) or IOperationCommunicationElement (IClientServerDataMapping) to an IAbstractSignalInstance (ISignalInstance or ISignalGroupInstance).
    IOperationCommunicationElement
    IOperationCommunicationElement represents an operation.
    ISenderReceiverDataMapping
    ISenderReceiverDataMapping represents the mapping of an IDataCommunicationElement to an ISignalInstance or ISignalGroupInstance.
    ISignalGroupInstance
    ISignalGroupInstance represents a system signal group which is at least referenced by an ISignalGroup.
    ISignalInstance
    ISignalInstance represents a system signal which is at least referenced by an ISignal or is a group signal.
    ITriggerCommunicationElement
    ITriggerCommunicationElement represents a trigger.
    ITriggerToSignalMapping
    ITriggerToSignalMapping represents the mapping of an ITriggerCommunicationElement to an ISignalInstance.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    ECompatibility
    ECompatibility represents the compatibility between an IAbstractSignalInstance and an ICommunicationElement for a potential or existing IDataMapping.
    EDirection
    Enumeration to express rx/tx or both directions.

Package com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.com Description
